purpose: silver_runways cleans the OurAirports runways extract into one row per runway, carrying per-end runway geometry and surface attributes to feed airport infrastructure, routing, and capacity analyses alongside the airports table.
usage: Join on airport_id (internal integer key) or airport_ident (external key matching airports.ident) to attach airport context; treat all low_end_* and high_end_* columns as optional per-end detail that may be null when the publisher has not recorded that end's geometry or displaced threshold; filter is_closed = true to exclude runways not currently in service.
limitations: Latitude, longitude, elevation, and heading columns for both runway ends carry null rates of roughly 22%-28%, and displaced threshold columns are null for about 88%-90% of rows, reflecting incomplete source records rather than cleanup loss; surface_code remains an open, non-enumerated set of 239 distinct codes and was not normalized into a fixed vocabulary.
